# Loading Data

## Motif data and Model Fits

```{R}
FullMotif_df <-read_csv('Butterfly Data/FullMotif_df.csv')

read_butterfly_outputs <- function(suffix, model_label) {
  
  files <- list.files(  "Butterfly_fits",recursive = TRUE,full.names = TRUE)
  expected_name <- paste0(model_label, "_", suffix)
  files <- files[basename(files) == expected_name]
  map_dfr(files, \(file) {
    read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(species = basename(dirname(file)))
  })
}

model_label <- "period_sd_08_O2"

pe_draws <- read_butterfly_outputs(suffix = "pe_effect_draws.csv", model_label)
pars     <- read_butterfly_outputs("parameter_summary.csv", model_label)
diag     <- read_butterfly_outputs("sampler_diagnostics.csv", model_label)
time_lookup    <-  read_butterfly_outputs("time_lookup.csv", model_label)
motif_fits    <-  read_butterfly_outputs("inferred_motif_frequencies.csv", model_label) 
```

## Butterfly Trait Data

```{R}

FocalSpNames = unique(pars$species) # names to match with

traits_raw <- read_csv( "Butterfly Data/ButterflyTraits/data/ecological_traits_2024.csv",
                        skip = 1 ) 
# Update names to match UKBMS data 
traits_clean_names <- traits_raw %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace_all(scientific_name, "(_|\\s)", " "),
         species = str_replace_all(species, "\xa0", " "),
         species = case_when( species =="Lysandra bellargus"~ "Polyommatus bellargus" ,
                              species =="Lysandra coridon" ~"Polyommatus coridon" ,
                              species ==  "Colias crocea"~"Colias croceus",
                              species == "Thymelicus sylvestris"~"Thymelicus lineola_sylvestris", # Copy Small Skipper traits
                              TRUE ~ species))%>%
  filter(species %in% FocalSpNames)

# Occupancy within dataset
FullMotif_df %>%
  mutate( species = ifelse(Sp == 'Thymelicus lineola/sylvestris', 'Thymelicus lineola_sylvestris', Sp ))%>%
  group_by(species)%>%
  summarise(Num_sites_Occu_inData = n_distinct(Site)) -> DataOccupancy ## beware potential statistical circularity

## Habitat Specificity, per Defra reports
##  https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/butterflies-in-the-wider-countryside-uk/butterflies-in-the-united-kingdom-and-in-england-1976-to-2024--2 

HabitatSpecialism <- read_csv('Butterfly Data/HabitatSpecialism.csv')

traits_clean_names$species 
traits_clean_names  %>%
  mutate(  univoltine = coalesce(obligate_univoltine == "1", FALSE)) %>%
  select(species,  family ,
         specificity, number_hostplants,
         univoltine = obligate_univoltine,
         abundance_trend,
         woodland_specialist  = `1. Woodland`,
         heathland_specialist = `2_heathland`,
         grassland_specialist = `4_grassland`,
         broadleaf_specialist = `1a_broadleaved_woodland`,
         size = wing_span_maximum) %>%
  mutate( specificity = ordered(specificity, levels = c("Monophagous", "Oligophagous (Genus)", 
                                                        "Oligophagous (Family)", "Polyphagous")),
          univoltine = !is.na(univoltine),
          woodland_specialist   = !is.na(woodland_specialist  ),
          heathland_specialist  = !is.na(heathland_specialist ),
          grassland_specialist   = !is.na(grassland_specialist  ),
          broadleaf_specialist  = !is.na(broadleaf_specialist ),
          wider_countryside_generalist = !woodland_specialist & !heathland_specialist)%>%
  left_join(DataOccupancy) -> traits
```


# PE Trends through time

## Overall Trend

```{r}
species_precision <- pe_draws %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(weight = 1 / var(pe_slope ), .groups = "drop")

overall_trend_summary <- pe_draws %>%
  inner_join(species_precision, by = "species") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(draw = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(draw) %>%
  summarise(unweighted_mean = mean(pe_slope) ,
            weighted_change = weighted.mean(pe_slope , weight),
            .groups = "drop") 

#### Unweighted trend
overall_trend_summary %>%
  summarise( Umean_change = mean(unweighted_mean),
             Uq025 = quantile(unweighted_mean, 0.025),
             Uq95 = quantile(unweighted_mean, 0.95),
             Uq05 = quantile(unweighted_mean, 0.05),
             Uq975 = quantile(unweighted_mean, 0.975),
             Upr_increase = mean(unweighted_mean > 0))-> unweighted_overall_trend

#### Trend Weighted by confidence
overall_trend_summary %>%
  summarise(w_mean_change = mean(weighted_change),
            wq025 = quantile(weighted_change, 0.025),
            wq95 = quantile(weighted_change, 0.95),
            wq05 = quantile(weighted_change, 0.05),
            wq975 = quantile(weighted_change, 0.975),
            wpr_increase = mean(weighted_change > 0))-> weighted_overall_trend

unweighted_overall_trend
weighted_overall_trend
```

```{R}
####
# Adding best Fit line
#####

linear_fit <- pe_draws %>%
  select(species, .draw, pe_intercept, pe_slope) %>%
  left_join( time_lookup %>% select(species, time_id, YEAR, time_scaled),
             by = "species", relationship = "many-to-many" ) %>%
  mutate(pe = pe_intercept + pe_slope * time_scaled) %>%
  group_by(species, time_id, YEAR, time_scaled) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(pe),
            q5 = quantile(pe, 0.05),
            q95 = quantile(pe, 0.95),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(series = "Linear fit")

pe_curves %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q5, ymax = q95), fill = 'red2',
              alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(colour = 'red2') +
  geom_line( aes(x = YEAR, y = mean), colour = 'black', data = linear_fit) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q5, ymax = q95),
              alpha = 0.1, colour = 'black', data = linear_fit) + 
  facet_wrap(~species, ncol = 5) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Expected Permutation Entropy") +
  guides(colour = "none", fill = "none")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c( NA,1))+
  theme_classic()

ggsave('MS_figs/SI_PEtrend_species.png', width =9, height =10)
```

Broadly, species that started with relatively low PE, became more random. 

Many species did not have strong structuring, and not much scope for further change. 

# Trait Drivers of Linear Trends: (SI Figure)

## Data Amalgamation 

```{r}
pars %>%
  filter( variable == 'pe_slope') %>%
  left_join(traits) %>%
  select(species,  PE_SLOPE = mean, family: Num_sites_Occu_inData)%>%
  mutate( abund_perc = parse_number(abundance_trend)) -> slopes_traits

filter(pars,  variable == 'pe_intercept') %>%
  select(PE_INTERCEPT = mean, species ) -> PE_intercept

left_join( slopes_traits,PE_intercept ) %>%
  mutate( family = factor(family),
          wider_countryside_generalist = factor(wider_countryside_generalist),
          univoltine = factor(univoltine),
          specificity = factor(specificity, ordered = FALSE)) ->slopes_traits
```

### Statistical Tests of 'Traits' versus Responses

```{r}
# Categorical predictors
m_Generalist       <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ wider_countryside_generalist, data = slopes_traits)
m_Diet_specificity <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ specificity,data = slopes_traits)
m_Univoltine       <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ univoltine,  data = slopes_traits)
m_Family           <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ family, data = slopes_traits)
# Continuous predictors
m_Size             <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ size, data = slopes_traits)
m_Site_occupancy   <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ Num_sites_Occu_inData,data = slopes_traits)
m_PE_intercept     <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ PE_INTERCEPT,data = slopes_traits)
m_Abundance_trend  <- lm(PE_SLOPE ~ abund_perc, data = slopes_traits)

models <- list( m_Generalist,   m_Diet_specificity, m_Univoltine,m_Family,           
                m_Size,m_Site_occupancy, m_PE_intercept,  m_Abundance_trend)

names(models) <- c('Habitat Generalism',   'Diet specificity', 'Univoltine','Family',           
                   'Size','Site occupancy', 'PE intercept',  'Abundance trend')

overall_tests <- map_df(names(models),
                        function(x) {
                          a <- anova(models[[x]])
                          s <- summary(models[[x]])
                          data.frame( trait = x,
                                      df = a$Df[1],
                                        n = nobs(models[[x]]),
                                      F.value = a$`F value`[1],
                                      p.value = a$`Pr(>F)`[1],
                                      R2 = s$r.squared,
                                      adj_R2 = s$adj.r.squared)
                        }) 

### Make label for Plots:
overall_tests <- overall_tests %>%
  mutate( stat_label = sprintf( "F = %.2f, p = %s, R2 = %.2f",
                                F.value,
                                ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                                                sprintf("%.3f", p.value)),
                                R2))

overall_tests
```

## Patterns of Motif shifts (Figure 5)

```{r}
pars %>%
  filter( variable == 'pe_slope') %>%
  arrange( desc(mean))

strong_species <- c("Aphantopus hyperantus","Maniola jurtina", "Pyronia tithonus")
focal_species<-strong_species

motif_key <- tribble( ~motif, ~motif_label, ~motif_class,
                      1L, "123", "Monotonic increase",
                      2L, "213", "Local trough",
                      3L, "312", "Local trough",
                      4L, "132", "Local peak",
                      5L, "231", "Local peak",
                      6L, "321", "Monotonic decrease")

motif_start_end <- motif_fits %>%
  filter( str_starts(variable, 'theta_')) %>%
  mutate(time_id = as.integer(str_match(variable, "\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 2]),
         motif   = as.integer(str_match(variable, "\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")[, 3]) ) %>%
  left_join(time_lookup, by = c("time_id", 'species'))%>%
  group_by(species, motif) %>%
  filter(time_id %in% range(time_id)) %>%
  mutate(stage = if_else(time_id == min(time_id), "Start", "End")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(motif_key, by = "motif") %>%
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = c("Start", "End")),
         x = motif + if_else(stage == "Start", -0.16, 0.16))%>%
  rename(  q5=`5%`, q95= `95%`)
```

```{R}
motif_summary <- bind_rows(
  # Focal species: retain model uncertainty
  motif_start_end %>%
    filter(species %in% strong_species) %>%
    transmute( panel = species, stage,
               motif,motif_label,motif_class,
               mean,lower = q5, upper = q95),
  
  # All OTHER species: distribution across species
  motif_start_end %>%
    filter(!species %in% strong_species) %>%
    group_by(stage, motif, motif_label, motif_class) %>%
    summarise(lower = quantile(mean, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
              estimate = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
              upper = quantile(mean, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop" ) %>%
    rename(mean = estimate) %>%
    mutate(panel = "All other species"),
  
  # ALL species: distribution across species
  motif_start_end %>%
    group_by(stage, motif, motif_label, motif_class) %>%
    summarise( lower = quantile(mean, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
               estimate = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
               upper = quantile(mean, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
               .groups = "drop"  ) %>%
    rename(mean = estimate) %>%
    mutate(panel = "All species")
) %>%
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = c("Start", "End")),
         panel = factor(  panel,
                          levels = c( strong_species,
                                      "All species", "All other species")),
         # horizontal offset for start/end
         x = motif + if_else(stage == "Start", -0.10, 0.10))
```

```{R}
motif_cols <- c( "Monotonic increase" = "#4CAF65","Monotonic decrease" = "#F0AD32",
                 "Local peak"         = "#DF6687","Local trough"       = "#4C81CF")

plot_motif_panel <- function(dat, title) {
  
  is_summary <- title %in% c("All species", "All other species")
  
  lines <- dat %>%
    select(motif, motif_class, stage, x, mean) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider( names_from = stage, values_from = c(x, mean))
  
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = x, y = mean)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1/6,
               colour = "grey70", linetype = 2 ) +
    geom_segment( data = lines,  # Start -> End connection
                  aes( x = x_Start, xend = x_End, 
                       y = mean_Start, yend = mean_End))
  # Different interval geometry for the two panel types
  if (is_summary) {
    # Across-species 5--95% range:
    # thicker, uncapped and slightly transparent
    p <- p + geom_linerange(aes( ymin = lower, ymax = upper, colour = motif_class),
                            linewidth = 0.8,alpha = 0.65)
  } else {
    # Focal-species model intervals:
    # conventional capped error bars
    p <- p + geom_errorbar(aes( ymin = lower, ymax = upper, colour = motif_class ),
                           width = 0.25,linewidth = 0.6)
  }
  
  p + geom_point(aes(colour = motif_class,shape = stage ),
                 size = 2.6, stroke = 0.9) +
    
    scale_shape_manual(values = c( "Start" = 1, "End"   = 16), name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = motif_cols,name = "Motif type") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = motif_key$motif, labels = motif_key$motif_label) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.7)) +
    labs( title = title,
          x =NULL,#"Three-point ordinal motif",
          y = NULL)+#"Estimated motif probability")
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text( hjust = 0.5,
                                     face = if (is_summary){"plain"}else{"italic"},
                                     size = 10) )
}

```


# Hierarchical Terms Analysis

Can years with motif consolidation be predicted from weather data?

### Processing Climate Data

```{r}
###########
# Temp
##########
ssn_HadCET_mean <- read_csv("Weather Data/cet_v2-1-1-0_meantemp-seasonal-totals.csv", 
                            skip = 38) 
baseline_means <- colMeans(filter(ssn_HadCET_mean,year >= 1961 & year <= 1990)[, 2:5], na.rm = TRUE)

processed_temp <- ssn_HadCET_mean %>%
  filter(year >= 1970) %>%            # Filter to match butterfly study range
  mutate(spring_temp_anom = spring  - baseline_means["spring"], # Compute active-season anomalies from the baseline
         summer_temp_anom = summer  - baseline_means["summer"],
         prev_summer_temp_anom = lag(summer_temp_anom, 1)) %>%  # Create lag variables
  select(Year=year, spring_temp_anom, summer_temp_anom, prev_summer_temp_anom)

#############
# Rainfall 
##########
HadSEEP_seasonal_totals <- read_table("Weather Data/HadSEEP_seasonal_totals.txt", skip = 2) ## read_table  collapses the variable width white spaces used by HadCET
means_seep    <- colMeans(filter(HadSEEP_seasonal_totals, Year >= 1961 & Year <= 1990)[, c("Win", "Spr", "Sum")],
                          na.rm = TRUE)

processed_seep <- HadSEEP_seasonal_totals %>%
  filter(Year >= 1980) %>%
  mutate(winter_rain_anom = Win - means_seep["Win"], # Current season anomalies (deviation from 1961-1990 average)
         spring_rain_anom = Spr - means_seep["Spr"],
         summer_rain_anom = Sum - means_seep["Sum"]) %>%
  mutate( prev_summer_rain_anom = lag(summer_rain_anom, 1) ) %>%
  select(Year, winter_rain_anom, spring_rain_anom, 
         summer_rain_anom, prev_summer_rain_anom)

### Join and build lags
butterfly_weather_drivers <- processed_temp %>%
  left_join(processed_seep, by = "Year") %>%
  arrange(Year)%>%
  filter( Year>=1980)# 2. Previous summer's rainfall

```


### Calculating Communty Average Deviations

```{R}
TimeLookup <- data.frame(time_id = 1:43,  Year =1980:2022 )

#Isolate both the raw entropy AND the smooth population trend profiles
extracted_entropy <- pars %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "pe_period_time|pe_population_time")) %>%
  mutate( time_id = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "\\d+")),  # Extract the 'g' time grid index out of the brackets
          type = if_else(str_detect(variable, "population"), "trend_baseline", "realized_period")) %>%  # Classify whether the row is the trend or the realisation
  select(Sp=species, time_id, type, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mean) %>%
  left_join(TimeLookup, by = "time_id")

# Standardise the residuals WITHIN each species across time
standardised_shocks <- extracted_entropy  %>%
  mutate(residual_PE = realized_period - trend_baseline  ) %>%# shared period-specific PE departure
  group_by(Sp) %>%
  mutate(mean_residual = mean(residual_PE, na.rm = TRUE), ## Centre the residuals on their historical average 
         sd_residual   = sd(residual_PE, na.rm = TRUE),
         pe_zscore = (residual_PE - mean_residual) / sd_residual   ) %>%# DETRENDED Z-SCORE: How unusual is this year relative to the species' expected trend?
  ungroup()

# Group by YEAR to find true community-wide anomalies
community_weather_analysis <- standardised_shocks %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(avg_community_zscore    = mean(pe_zscore, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_community_zscore     = sd(pe_zscore, na.rm = TRUE),
            pct_species_below_avg   = sum(pe_zscore < 0) / n() * 100   ) %>%   # % of species where entropy dropped lower than their own average
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_community_zscore )))  # Rank by the most unbalaneced set of species 

print(community_weather_analysis)

```

### Does weird weather predict deviations?

```{r}

final_analysis_df <- community_weather_analysis %>%
  left_join(butterfly_weather_drivers, by = "Year")


timeline_combined_df  <- final_analysis_df %>%
  mutate(z_spring_temp = (spring_temp_anom - mean(spring_temp_anom, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(spring_temp_anom, na.rm = TRUE),  # Standardise Temp Anomaly
         z_summer_temp = (summer_temp_anom - mean(summer_temp_anom, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(summer_temp_anom, na.rm = TRUE),
         
         z_summer_rain = (summer_rain_anom - mean(summer_rain_anom, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(summer_rain_anom, na.rm = TRUE),  # Standardise  Rain Anom
         z_spring_rain = (spring_rain_anom - mean(spring_rain_anom, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(spring_rain_anom, na.rm = TRUE))

### rescaling axis
max_weather <- max(c(timeline_combined_df$z_spring_temp,
                     timeline_combined_df$z_summer_temp,
                     timeline_combined_df$z_summer_rain), na.rm = TRUE)
min_weather <- min(c(timeline_combined_df$z_spring_temp, 
                     timeline_combined_df$z_summer_temp, 
                     timeline_combined_df$z_summer_rain), na.rm = TRUE)

max_pe <- max(timeline_combined_df$avg_community_zscore, na.rm = TRUE)
min_pe <- min(timeline_combined_df$avg_community_zscore, na.rm = TRUE)

# This compression factor shrinks the weather lines so they fit into the PE frame in the ggplot
compress_factor <- (max_pe - min_pe) / (max_weather - min_weather)

ggplot(timeline_combined_df, aes(x = Year)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1997.5, xmax = 2000.5, ymin = min_pe - 0.1, ymax = max_pe + 0.1, alpha = 0.2, fill =  "orange") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2002.5, xmax = 2003.5, ymin = min_pe - 0.1, ymax = max_pe + 0.1, alpha = 0.2, fill ="darkred") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2010.5, xmax = 2012.5, ymin = min_pe - 0.1, ymax = max_pe + 0.1, alpha = 0.2, fill = "dodgerblue") +
  
  geom_line(aes(y = z_spring_temp * compress_factor, color = "Spring Temp Anomaly"), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = z_summer_temp * compress_factor, color = "Summer Temp Anomaly"), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = z_summer_rain * compress_factor, color = "Summer Rain Anomaly"), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = z_spring_rain * compress_factor, color = "Spring Rain Anomaly"), linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_community_zscore, color = "Community PE Z-Score"), linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_community_zscore, color = "Community PE Z-Score"), size = 2.2) +
  
  scale_y_continuous( name = "PE Deviation\n(Community Average Z-Score)",
                      limits = c(min_pe - 0.1, max_pe + 0.1),
                      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / compress_factor,
                                          name = "Weather Variable Anomalies\n(Z-score Over Time Period)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 11)+
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL,
                     values = c(  "Community PE Z-Score" = "black",
                                  "Spring Temp Anomaly"  = "orange", "Summer Temp Anomaly"  = "red",
                                  "Summer Rain Anomaly"  = "blue",  "Spring Rain Anomaly" = 'lightblue')) +
  
  labs( x = "Year",
        # title = "Overlaid Timelines of Community Structure and Local Climate Drivers",
        #subtitle = "Shaded regions higlight unusual periods"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme( legend.position = "bottom",
         panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
         plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
         axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "black"),
         axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "grey30"), 
         legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
         legend.spacing.x = unit(0.15, "cm")) -> Fig5a

Fig5a

```

## Motif shifts in most extreme years

```{R}
#  Load the raw event data and filter for our two focal years
## includes all species. NB will be weigthed by number of time series for each species
raw_events <- FullMotif_df %>%
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2011, 2003)) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = factor(YEAR))

# Calculate the empirical proportions of each motif within each year
motif_proportions <- raw_events %>%
  count(YEAR, Motif, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(motif_key, by = c('Motif' ="motif"))

FullMotif_df %>%
  count(Motif, name = "count") %>%
  mutate(YEAR = 'All',
         proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  left_join(motif_key, by = c('Motif' ="motif")) -> OverallProp

bind_rows(motif_proportions,
          OverallProp) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = factor(YEAR, levels = c("All", "2003", "2011"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Motif, y = proportion, fill = YEAR)) +
  scale_x_continuous( breaks = motif_key$motif,labels = motif_key$motif_label )+
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2003" = "red", 
                               "2011" = "skyblue",
                               "All"  = "grey"),
                    labels = c( "2003" = "2003","2011" = "2011","All"  = "1980–2022"), 
                    name = NULL)+ 
  ylab('Observed Motif Frequency\n(All Species and Sites)')+
  xlab('Motif' )+
  theme_classic()+
  # theme(legend.position = "inside",
  #   legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98),
  #   legend.justification = c(1, 1))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")-> Fig5c

Fig5c
```

### Testing a regression tree model

Key problem, weird weather can cause species to converge, or to split in their dynamics. 
Regression tree to see if there is any predictive information in these weather variables

```{r}
tree_data <- final_analysis_df %>%
  select(Year, avg_community_zscore, 
         spring_temp_anom:prev_summer_rain_anom )

# Fit a  Regression Tree (maxdepth = 3 and minsplit = 8 to limit overfitting)
pe_tree <- rpart(avg_community_zscore ~ spring_temp_anom + summer_temp_anom + 
                   winter_rain_anom + summer_rain_anom+
                   prev_summer_rain_anom,
                 data = tree_data,
                 method = "anova", # Tells rpart to run a regression tree for continuous data
                 control = rpart.control(maxdepth = 3, minsplit = 8, cp = 0.05))

print(pe_tree)

# extra = 101 displays the average Z-score and the % of years falling into that bin
rpart.plot(pe_tree, type = 4, extra = 101, 
           fallen.leaves = TRUE, box.palette = "RdBu", # Red for positive spikes, Blue for negative drops
           shadow.col = "grey90",main = "Climatic Thresholds Governing Community Entropy Z-Scores")

summary(pe_tree)
printcp(pe_tree)

```
